title: Defense and transition to P
goal: Defend the applied work and make a transfer change without losing the earlier result.
prerequisites: 1c-enterprise.a 7; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
outcomes: Defend the applied work and make a transfer change without losing the earlier result.
Explain three design choices in your model.
Make an independent transfer change in a copy.
sections: Show model, workflows, checks and recovery rather than reciting definitions. Explain field types, references versus names and rejected-write behavior. Review questions concern the actual deliverable. A local system may preserve answers as self-report but cannot call that an independent defense.

The final project transfers skills to an independent dataset. Use a new instance with permitted-template provenance and prior requirements. Entry, search, reporting and recovery form one workflow. Replace “build a system” with observable action outcomes. Screen count/archive size do not measure correctness, and a successful demonstration does not eliminate negative tests.

Add a filter or report variant for another period. Predict the result, create a copy and change it without a solved walkthrough. Then repeat prior workflows. Explaining the consequences of a changed condition demonstrates understanding better than replaying a memorized click sequence.

Choose data that distinguishes defects. Multiple customers, equal labels with different identities, zero duration and varied statuses expose filter/grouping errors. Calculate expectations independently before running reports. When wrong solutions coincide numerically, add a discriminating case. Never rewrite the oracle to fit output or call an explanatory model actual 1C execution.

An applied graduate operates the system and performs foundational configuration within scope. Professional P adds algorithms, modules, queries and engineering verification. Shared concepts help, but A completion does not automatically complete P topics. Transition creates a new work copy with provenance rather than transferring unrelated competency credit.

Preservation is critical. Keep prior results, source infobase and attempts available. Restore to a fresh directory, edit only the copy and reread the source. A startup screenshot does not prove this chain. Portfolios identify versions, work IDs, control identities, expected/observed values, negative cases and environment limits. This makes independent reproduction possible without accessing private data.
The final package remains learner work

Preserve the pre-defense version, changed copy, answers and transfer-check results. Do not erase attempts to beautify the record. Declare templates and assistance without claiming unverified independent authorship. Instructor grading and certification belong to a separate process that local self-checking does not replace.

Defend choices against the actual submission:field type, rejection rule and source of a total. Make a small transfer change in another copy. Declare templates and assistance honestly. A local self-report is neither instructor grading nor authorship verification. AandPare independent:a project copy can support learning without automatically transferring completion credit.
